Easter at
Faith Life.

Celebrate the resurrection of Jesus with us on Easter Sunday, March 28, 2027, at 1:30 PM. Everyone is welcome.

Walk through the weekend

  1. Friday · Good Friday

    “It is finished.”

    John 19:30

    On Good Friday we join the Filipino Interchurch Fellowship Winnipeg for their service. Faith Life doesn’t hold a separate Good Friday service.

    Ask about this year’s time and place

  2. Saturday · Holy Saturday

    A quiet day
    of waiting.

    The tomb is sealed and the world is quiet. Take a few minutes to pray, and read how the story ends before Sunday.

    Read Matthew 27 (BSB)

  3. Sunday · Easter Sunday

    He is risen.

    “He is not here; He has risen, just as He said!”

    Matthew 28:6

    Easter Sunday28March 20271:30 PM · 427 Matheson AvenueIn the chapel of Faith Academy. Come in through the school’s front door.

Every Sunday
is for you, too.

Easter is a wonderful Sunday to bring a friend, and so is every Sunday, because the gospel is preached every week.
